_metadata.description: Agricultural crop requirements knowledge base for FarmFriend AI
sources: ICAR (Indian Council of Agricultural Research) crop production guides
TNAU (Tamil Nadu Agricultural University) crop production technology
Maharashtra State Department of Agriculture crop advisory
ICAR-National Bureau of Soil Survey and Land Use Planning (NBSS&LUP)
_metadata.disclaimer: Thresholds represent general guidelines from published scientific sources. Actual requirements vary by variety, microclimate, and local conditions. Consult local Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) for site-specific advice.

soil.notes: Requires water-retentive soils; poorly suited to sandy or well-drained soils
soil.source: ICAR crop production guide for rice

ph.notes: Tolerates slightly acidic to neutral soils; very alkaline soils reduce yield

N.notes: High nitrogen feeder; nitrogen critical for tillering

K.notes: Potassium improves grain quality and disease resistance

temperature.notes: Tropical crop; sensitive to cold temperatures at flowering

humidity.notes: High humidity typical in paddy-growing regions

rainfall.notes: High water requirement; puddling/flooding or heavy irrigation preferred
rainfall.source: ICAR / FAO Crop Ecology Database / VNMKV Guidelines

irrigation.notes: Paddy requires standing water; upland rice needs less but still high irrigation

drainage.notes: Poor drainage beneficial for paddy cultivation
